name: stackvet-vscode
description: Universal project health and static diagnostics engine for VS Code

stackvet.executablePath.description: Path to the StackVet executable. If left empty, 'stackvet' is resolved from PATH.

stackvet.autoScan.description: Automatically check files and workspace for issues on open, change, and save.

stackvet.scanMode.description: Analysis scope: 'openFilesOnly' (Pyright-style: rescan only active/saved files) or 'workspace' (rescan entire project).

stackvet.autoScanOnSave.description: Automatically run StackVet scan whenever a file is saved.

stackvet.autoScanOnOpen.description: Automatically run StackVet scan when a workspace is opened.

stackvet.allowLiveFallback.description: Allow falling back to live network execution via npx or pipx if no local StackVet binary is found.

stackvet.timeout.description: Maximum execution time in milliseconds before a StackVet scan is timed out.
